title: Official CORE SMP Modpack
description: This is the official CORE SMP modpack, this pack is meant to bring performance packs to light for the people of CORE SMP.
body:
We’re excited to officially release the CORE SMP Modpack, a feature-rich, quality-of-life–focused collection of server-approved mods designed to make your gameplay smoother, more immersive, and even more fun. Whether you’re here to build, explore, trade, or just hang out, this pack is tailored to enhance your survival experience without breaking our vanilla-friendly spirit.

✨ Key Features
All Mods Approved for CORE SMP – No more guessing what’s allowed. Everything in this pack is 100% safe to use on our server.

Quality of Life Upgrades – Improved performance, better UI, visual enhancements, minimaps, and more to make every moment in Minecraft feel better.

Custom CORE SMP Title Screen – A personalized welcome every time you load the game, putting you right into the CORE SMP vibe from the start.

Performance Boosters – Tweaks and optimizations to keep your FPS high and lag low, even in the busiest areas.

Immersion-Friendly Enhancements – Subtle sound, lighting, and interface improvements that make the world feel more alive without straying from vanilla aesthetics.

🛠 Why Use the Official Modpack?
Instant Compatibility – No need to hunt for downloads or manage your own mod list — everything’s preconfigured.

Peace of Mind – You’ll never risk breaking server rules with disallowed mods.

Streamlined Multiplayer – Load in faster, play smoother, and stay synced with the community.

Consistent Experience – Everyone using the pack sees the same improvements, making collaboration seamless.
